jobs.title: Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist
jobs.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. \n Summary We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have): Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. \n What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: RevOps Analyst
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented RevOps Analyst to support and scale Sprinto’s outbound pipeline through high-quality market research, data enrichment, CRM management, account prioritization, and GTM operations. The role combines market and prospect research with hands-on GTM Operations , giving the candidate ownership across account and contact intelligence, signals and scoring, data quality, lead routing, CRM processes, and outbound infrastructure. The ideal candidate has experience in Market Research, Sales Research, or MRE roles , along with an interest in expanding into RevOps and GTM systems. They should be comfortable working with enrichment platforms, CRM systems, routing logic, account prioritization, automation workflows, and data governance. \n Where you'll leave your mark? Conduct primary and secondary research to identify ICP-fit accounts and contacts across target industries and geographies. Build and maintain high-quality outbound databases with accurate, complete, and campaign-ready contact information. Source and enrich account and contact data using Clay/Bitscale/Cargo, Apollo/ZoomInfo/Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator , and similar platforms. Research and map buying groups, personas, and relevant stakeholders within target accounts. Identify and capture relevant account and contact signals that indicate ICP fit, buying intent, business change, or sales opportunity. Develop and maintain account and contact scoring and prioritization frameworks to help Sales teams focus on the highest-value opportunities. Segment and prioritize accounts and contacts based on ICP criteria, signals, persona, employee size, geography, revenue, technology stack, and other relevant attributes. Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to understand pipeline and coverage requirements and ensure sales teams have a sufficient supply of qualified, prioritized accounts and contacts . Design and optimize data enrichment and automation workflows to improve data coverage, accuracy, and scalability. Maintain HubSpot CRM hygiene , including data validation, field standardization, lifecycle stages, ownership, and regular audits. Identify, manage, and eliminate duplicate accounts and contacts. Support lead, contact, and account routing based on territory, persona, employee size, geography, account ownership, and other GTM criteria. Audit routing and assignment outputs to identify incorrect ownership, unassigned records, duplicates, and other data issues. Support the implementation and maintenance of lead and account assignment logic in HubSpot. Assist with CRM data governance, segmentation, enrichment, and operational workflows. Monitor account coverage and identify gaps in target account and contact coverage , proactively addressing them through research and enrichment. Collaborate with SDRs, AEs, Marketing and RevOps teams to troubleshoot data and operational issues. Support GTM Operations projects involving CRM workflows, automation, enrichment, routing, scoring, prioritization, and data orchestration . The kind of builder we're looking for - 2–3 years of experience in Market Research, Market Research Executive (MRE), GTM Engineering, Sales Research, or similar roles. Strong hands-on experience with account and contact research, ICP identification, persona mapping, and prospect data sourcing . Experience with tools such as Clay, Bitscale, Cargo, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator , or similar enrichment and prospecting platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills are required. Working knowledge of HubSpot or another CRM . Understanding of CRM data hygiene, deduplication, enrichment, segmentation, and data governance. Understanding of account scoring, signal-based prioritization, and lead/account qualification is preferred. Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets while maintaining data accuracy. Ability to translate business requirements into structured data, processes, scoring frameworks, and operational workflows . Ability to work with Sales and Marketing teams to understand account coverage requirements and translate them into actionable research and data programs . Interest in RevOps, GTM systems, automation, and sales technology . Basic understanding of automation, APIs, or scripting such as JavaScript is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-oriented mindset. Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with Sales, SDR, Marketing, and RevOps teams. \n How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are : We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house : If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning : We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves : Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams : We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

jobs.title: GTM AI Operations - India
jobs.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. \n What You'll Be Doing: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST \n #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" #LI-Remote #BI-Remote

needs_verification.title: Senior Content Analyst
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Map payer, plan, HCP, and provider records into governed hierarchies by reconciling inconsistent names, identifiers, relationships, and structures across multiple data sources. Conduct online and source-based research to validate and enrich records, including plan types, parent organizations, PBM relationships, provider affiliations, and other relevant attributes. Assign confidence ratings, document mapping rationale, prepare outputs for senior review, and perform quality control on junior-analyst work. Monitor, cleanse, validate, and enrich data while identifying and resolving exceptions and recurring data-quality issues. Establish and maintain data quality standards, data dictionaries, metadata, data lineage, governance policies, procedures, and documentation. Conduct data profiling and analysis, identify root causes of data-quality problems, and recommend practical improvements. Develop and maintain data-quality dashboards, scorecards, reports, and other data-management tools using modern analytics technologies. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Content, Delivery, and Client Success teams to integrate data-management processes into development and delivery workflows. Support continuous improvement and automation initiatives, including the responsible operationalization of AI/ML-assisted mapping with appropriate human oversight. Train colleagues and end users on data-management, mapping, governance, and quality best practices. Help ensure data-management practices align with applicable privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. Gather feedback from internal users and external clients and translate their needs into meaningful improvements to data products and processes. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. 3–5 years of relevant experience in payer analytics, formulary or claims data management, content mapping, data governance, or a closely related field. Strong understanding of formulary data, patient claims data, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, and data governance principles. Experience with payer and/or HCP/provider mapping, content research, SQL, data modeling, and database management systems. Experience with master data management (MDM), data profiling, and data-analysis tools. At least 2 years of combined professional experience working with United States healthcare data. Advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI for analysis, reporting, visualization, and dashboard development. Knowledge of data privacy, security, and regulatory compliance requirements. Experience with Reltio, Informatica, or comparable master data management platforms is desirable. Familiarity with Snowflake is a plus. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, critical reasoning, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Ability to translate complex data and mapping concepts into clear, actionable communication for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong written, verbal, presentation, collaboration, task-management, and conflict-resolution skills. Demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues, share knowledge, exercise sound judgment, and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. Comfortable collaborating with global stakeholders across different teams, cultures, and time zones. Must be legally authorized to work in India without employer sponsorship. Benefits Remote work opportunity within India. Exposure to global healthcare data, market-access analytics, and payer/provider intelligence. Opportunity to work with cross-functional teams spanning Product, Engineering, Content, Delivery, and Client Success. Hands-on involvement in data governance, master data management, analytics, and AI/ML-assisted data operations. Professional development through knowledge sharing, mentoring, and exposure to modern data-management practices. Opportunity to contribute directly to data quality, operational efficiency, and product improvements. Compensation and other employment benefits are determined by the hiring company and applicable local employment terms. needs_verification.title: Product Analyst
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Represent the Product team across active projects and participate in daily application operations and development stand-ups. Support data delivery for clients using the products and collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain high-quality data products. Analyze large U.S. healthcare claims datasets to identify patterns, data-quality issues, coverage gaps, and opportunities for product improvement. Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, profiling, reconciliation, validation, and impact analysis. Compare datasets and product outputs to assess the impact of source changes, updated business rules, data-period changes, and product enhancements. Investigate complex data and product issues, perform root-cause analysis, evaluate business impact, and recommend practical solutions. Analyze medical and pharmacy claims, prescription, payer, formulary, and patient-level data across relevant patient, claim, payer, and plan dimensions. Support validation of product outputs, analytical processes, data transformations, and machine-learning-generated results. Create and maintain product documentation, including data dictionaries, business rules, requirements, test scenarios, and validation results. Support functional, regression, and user acceptance testing, as well as data validation and defect investigation. Contribute to feasibility assessments and proof-of-concept initiatives for new healthcare data and analytics capabilities. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. 1–3 years of experience in healthcare analytics, product analysis, business analysis, data analysis, or a related role. Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous business questions, investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and develop actionable recommendations. Strong hands-on experience with SQL, Power BI, and Microsoft Excel. Practical experience analyzing U.S. healthcare data, including exposure to medical or pharmacy claims, patient-level data, formulary data, market-access data, or equivalent healthcare datasets. Familiarity with healthcare data sources such as claims, payer, formulary, and patient datasets is highly relevant. Experience with Snowflake is preferred. Understanding of medical and pharmacy claims, payer hierarchies, BIN-PCN-Group data, formulary data, market access, or patient-services analytics is an advantage. Exposure to longitudinal patient analysis, treatment patterns, patient journeys, or payer-access analytics is beneficial. Familiarity with Python, APIs, JSON, or machine-learning output validation is a plus. Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or Agile product-development practices is advantageous. Working knowledge of U.S. healthcare or market access is preferred. Experience working within a HIPAA-compliant environment is beneficial. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and concisely. Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, including the ability to work across functions, give and receive constructive feedback, and support the productionization of processes. Strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to connect detailed analysis to broader project and business objectives. Solutions-oriented, resourceful, and resilient approach to navigating ambiguity, obstacles, and changing priorities. Willingness to travel domestically and/or internationally, including occasional overnight travel of up to 5%. Benefits: Fully remote work arrangement in India. Opportunity to work on healthcare data products and analytics supporting U.S. healthcare markets. Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Engagement, and Account teams. Exposure to large-scale healthcare datasets, advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-driven product development. Opportunity to contribute to product validation, new analytics capabilities, and proof-of-concept initiatives. Collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making. Professional exposure to U.S. healthcare, market access, and healthcare analytics practices. needs_verification.title: CRA (Level II)
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Conduct remote and on-site monitoring visits using a risk-based monitoring approach, assessing protocol compliance, data quality, investigational product accountability, and site processes. Perform source data review, source data verification, CRF review, and essential document checks as required by study specifications. Identify site deficiencies and risks through critical thinking and root-cause analysis, recommend corrective and preventive actions, and follow issues through to resolution. Maintain regular communication with investigative sites between monitoring visits to support protocol adherence, timely data entry, and resolution of previously identified findings. Initiate clinical trial sites, support investigator identification and meetings, and contribute to site close-out activities and retrieval of trial materials. Ensure essential documents are complete and maintained in accordance with ICH-GCP and applicable regulatory requirements. Provide study status updates, progress reports, and accurate information in clinical trial management systems. Facilitate effective communication between investigative sites, project teams, and clients through written, verbal, and electronic communication. Respond to applicable company, client, regulatory, audit, and inspection requirements. Complete administrative activities, including expense reports and timesheets, accurately and on time. Contribute to project tools, publications, process improvements, and other initiatives that strengthen clinical trial delivery and team effectiveness. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences-related field, Registered Nursing certification, or an equivalent relevant academic or vocational qualification. At least 2 years of on-site clinical monitoring experience, with a background that provides the knowledge and skills required for the role. Based in a major Indian metropolitan location such as Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Pune. Proven clinical monitoring capabilities and a strong understanding of medical or therapeutic terminology. Working knowledge of ICH-GCP requirements, applicable regulations, and clinical research procedures. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, including experience with root-cause analysis and risk-based monitoring concepts. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with close attention to detail. Effective interpersonal, written, oral, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate confidently with medical personnel and study stakeholders. Strong customer focus, listening skills, and the ability to identify and address underlying site or stakeholder concerns. Ability to remain flexible and adaptable across changing study requirements and environments. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary project team. Solid computer skills, including Microsoft Office proficiency and the ability to learn relevant clinical systems and software. Good English-language and grammar skills. Willingness and ability to travel frequently, generally around 60–80%, including potential overnight stays. Comfortable working in environments that may involve exposure to clinical sites, biological fluids, infectious organisms, protective equipment, and varying environmental conditions. Benefits Full-time position with a standard Monday–Friday work schedule. Opportunity to contribute to clinical research and support the delivery of pharmaceutical and biotechnology studies. Exposure to international clinical trial projects, investigative sites, and multidisciplinary teams. Combination of remote and on-site clinical monitoring activities. Professional development through hands-on experience with clinical monitoring, risk-based approaches, regulatory requirements, and study management. Opportunity to contribute to process improvement initiatives and broader project work. Work environment designed to support collaboration, learning, and development within a global clinical research organization. strong_shortlist.title: Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist
strong_shortlist.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. \n Summary We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have): Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. \n What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

strong_shortlist.title: RevOps Analyst
strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented RevOps Analyst to support and scale Sprinto’s outbound pipeline through high-quality market research, data enrichment, CRM management, account prioritization, and GTM operations. The role combines market and prospect research with hands-on GTM Operations , giving the candidate ownership across account and contact intelligence, signals and scoring, data quality, lead routing, CRM processes, and outbound infrastructure. The ideal candidate has experience in Market Research, Sales Research, or MRE roles , along with an interest in expanding into RevOps and GTM systems. They should be comfortable working with enrichment platforms, CRM systems, routing logic, account prioritization, automation workflows, and data governance. \n Where you'll leave your mark? Conduct primary and secondary research to identify ICP-fit accounts and contacts across target industries and geographies. Build and maintain high-quality outbound databases with accurate, complete, and campaign-ready contact information. Source and enrich account and contact data using Clay/Bitscale/Cargo, Apollo/ZoomInfo/Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator , and similar platforms. Research and map buying groups, personas, and relevant stakeholders within target accounts. Identify and capture relevant account and contact signals that indicate ICP fit, buying intent, business change, or sales opportunity. Develop and maintain account and contact scoring and prioritization frameworks to help Sales teams focus on the highest-value opportunities. Segment and prioritize accounts and contacts based on ICP criteria, signals, persona, employee size, geography, revenue, technology stack, and other relevant attributes. Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to understand pipeline and coverage requirements and ensure sales teams have a sufficient supply of qualified, prioritized accounts and contacts . Design and optimize data enrichment and automation workflows to improve data coverage, accuracy, and scalability. Maintain HubSpot CRM hygiene , including data validation, field standardization, lifecycle stages, ownership, and regular audits. Identify, manage, and eliminate duplicate accounts and contacts. Support lead, contact, and account routing based on territory, persona, employee size, geography, account ownership, and other GTM criteria. Audit routing and assignment outputs to identify incorrect ownership, unassigned records, duplicates, and other data issues. Support the implementation and maintenance of lead and account assignment logic in HubSpot. Assist with CRM data governance, segmentation, enrichment, and operational workflows. Monitor account coverage and identify gaps in target account and contact coverage , proactively addressing them through research and enrichment. Collaborate with SDRs, AEs, Marketing and RevOps teams to troubleshoot data and operational issues. Support GTM Operations projects involving CRM workflows, automation, enrichment, routing, scoring, prioritization, and data orchestration . The kind of builder we're looking for - 2–3 years of experience in Market Research, Market Research Executive (MRE), GTM Engineering, Sales Research, or similar roles. Strong hands-on experience with account and contact research, ICP identification, persona mapping, and prospect data sourcing . Experience with tools such as Clay, Bitscale, Cargo, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator , or similar enrichment and prospecting platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills are required. Working knowledge of HubSpot or another CRM . Understanding of CRM data hygiene, deduplication, enrichment, segmentation, and data governance. Understanding of account scoring, signal-based prioritization, and lead/account qualification is preferred. Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets while maintaining data accuracy. Ability to translate business requirements into structured data, processes, scoring frameworks, and operational workflows . Ability to work with Sales and Marketing teams to understand account coverage requirements and translate them into actionable research and data programs . Interest in RevOps, GTM systems, automation, and sales technology . Basic understanding of automation, APIs, or scripting such as JavaScript is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-oriented mindset. Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with Sales, SDR, Marketing, and RevOps teams. \n How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are : We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house : If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning : We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves : Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams : We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

strong_shortlist.title: GTM AI Operations - India
strong_shortlist.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. \n What You'll Be Doing: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST \n #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" #LI-Remote #BI-Remote

strong_shortlist.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. \n Where you'll leave your mark? Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for - 1 to 3 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders \n How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are : We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house : If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning : We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves : Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams : We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

Establish and maintain data quality standards, data dictionaries, metadata, data lineage, governance policies, procedures, and documentation. Conduct data profiling and analysis, identify root causes of data-quality problems, and recommend practical improvements. Develop and maintain data-quality dashboards, scorecards, reports, and other data-management tools using modern analytics technologies. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Content, Delivery, and Client Success teams to integrate data-management processes into development and delivery workflows. Support continuous improvement and automation initiatives, including the responsible operationalization of AI/ML-assisted mapping with appropriate human oversight. Train colleagues and end users on data-management, mapping, governance, and quality best practices. Help ensure data-management practices align with applicable privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. Gather feedback from internal users and external clients and translate their needs into meaningful improvements to data products and processes. Strong understanding of formulary data, patient claims data, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, and data governance principles. Experience with payer and/or HCP/provider mapping, content research, SQL, data modeling, and database management systems. Experience with master data management (MDM), data profiling, and data-analysis tools. At least 2 years of combined professional experience working with United States healthcare data. Advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI for analysis, reporting, visualization, and dashboard development. Knowledge of data privacy, security, and regulatory compliance requirements. Experience with Reltio, Informatica, or comparable master data management platforms is desirable. Familiarity with Snowflake is a plus. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, critical reasoning, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Ability to translate complex data and mapping concepts into clear, actionable communication for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong written, verbal, presentation, collaboration, task-management, and conflict-resolution skills. Demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues, share knowledge, exercise sound judgment, and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. Comfortable collaborating with global stakeholders across different teams, cultures, and time zones. Must be legally authorized to work in India without employer sponsorship. Benefits Remote work opportunity within India. Exposure to global healthcare data, market-access analytics, and payer/provider intelligence. Opportunity to work with cross-functional teams spanning Product, Engineering, Content, Delivery, and Client Success. Hands-on involvement in data governance, master data management, analytics, and AI/ML-assisted data operations. Initiate clinical trial sites, support investigator identification and meetings, and contribute to site close-out activities and retrieval of trial materials. Ensure essential documents are complete and maintained in accordance with ICH-GCP and applicable regulatory requirements. Provide study status updates, progress reports, and accurate information in clinical trial management systems. Facilitate effective communication between investigative sites, project teams, and clients through written, verbal, and electronic communication. Respond to applicable company, client, regulatory, audit, and inspection requirements. Complete administrative activities, including expense reports and timesheets, accurately and on time. Contribute to project tools, publications, process improvements, and other initiatives that strengthen clinical trial delivery and team effectiveness. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences-related field, Registered Nursing certification, or an equivalent relevant academic or vocational qualification. At least 2 years of on-site clinical monitoring experience, with a background that provides the knowledge and skills required for the role. Based in a major Indian metropolitan location such as Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Pune. Proven clinical monitoring capabilities and a strong understanding of medical or therapeutic terminology. Working knowledge of ICH-GCP requirements, applicable regulations, and clinical research procedures. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, including experience with root-cause analysis and risk-based monitoring concepts. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with close attention to detail. Effective interpersonal, written, oral, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate confidently with medical personnel and study stakeholders. Strong customer focus, listening skills, and the ability to identify and address underlying site or stakeholder concerns. Ability to remain flexible and adaptable across changing study requirements and environments. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary project team. Solid computer skills, including Microsoft Office proficiency and the ability to learn relevant clinical systems and software. Good English-language and grammar skills. Willingness and ability to travel frequently, generally around 60–80%, including potential overnight stays. Comfortable working in environments that may involve exposure to clinical sites, biological fluids, infectious organisms, protective equipment, and varying environmental conditions. Exposure to international clinical trial projects, investigative sites, and multidisciplinary teams. Combination of remote and on-site clinical monitoring activities. Professional development through hands-on experience with clinical monitoring, risk-based approaches, regulatory requirements, and study management. Opportunity to contribute to process improvement initiatives and broader project work. Work environment designed to support collaboration, learning, and development within a global clinical research organization.
